# foreman_computeprofile (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_computeprofile" "small_vm" {
  name = "1-CPU 2GB"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the computeprofile to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
